body: Design a vertical campaign poster for {{brand}} using the supplied product or person image. Divide the page into an intentional grid of large rectangles and quarter-circle shapes in this brand palette: {{palette}}. Let parts of the photographed subject cross the geometric boundaries while other parts are masked. Use a clear focal point, small logo placement and minimal text.

en.title: Geometric brand poster
en.description: Product photography crosses a grid of large color blocks and curves.
en.body:
## How to use

Upload one product or person photo and supply a brand name and palette.

Keep the photographed subject recognizable across masked boundaries.

## Recorded result

The example was generated with the built-in image tool. Its exact model ID was not returned. The recorded run contains the submitted prompt and ordered inputs.

## 使用方法

准备：人物或产品照片、品牌配色。产品照片穿过大色块与弧线构成的几何网格。

## 实测结果

样例由内置图像工具生成，工具未返回精确模型 ID。运行记录保存实际提交的提示词与有序参考图。本站人物、房间、宠物和服饰参考均为原创合成素材。
